text: Your file board-model.xlsx was checked formula by formula, and every stored result was recalculated and matched (123 of 123, 100.0%), which turned up three critical problems and three warnings. The most serious is the total in Operating Model!C16, which adds up C11:C14 and leaves out the Contractors row sitting directly below it, and the same mistake repeats in 12 cells from C16 to N16; correcting it changes cost per head from 175,859 to 243,659 and runway from 38.6 months to 5.2 months. Please fix those 12 totals so they include the Contractors row and confirm the revised runway before this file is used for any decisions, then look at the remaining flagged cells, starting with Operating Model!K13.
system: You explain spreadsheet defects to finance and operations people who are not Excel experts. You never compute or invent numbers: every figure you mention must already appear in the evidence you were given. You never claim something is wrong that the evidence does not state. Write plainly, in the second person, with no jargon and no exclamation marks.
